{"sql":"SELECT g.GenreId, g.Name AS Genre, 
       SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS revenue,
       SUM(t.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS cost,
       SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) - SUM(t.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS profit,
       CASE WHEN SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity)=0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND((SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) - SUM(t.UnitPrice * il.Quantity)) / SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 4)
       END AS profit_margin
FROM InvoiceLine il
JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
LEFT JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name
ORDER BY profit_margin DESC;"}

SELECT g.GenreId, g.Name AS Genre, 
       SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS revenue,
       SUM(t.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS cost,
       SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) - SUM(t.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS profit,
       CASE WHEN SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity)=0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND((SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) - SUM(t.UnitPrice * il.Quantity)) / SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 4)
       END AS profit_margin
FROM InvoiceLine il
JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
LEFT JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name
ORDER BY profit_margin DESC;
